description: This file is a shell script used for testing 'git rev-parse --verify' functionality. It sets up a test repository, adds and commits lines to a file, verifies revision hashes, and checks various behaviors of the git command under different parameters and edge cases.

methods.name: add_line_into_file
methods.description: Adds a line to a specified file, creating the file if it does not exist, then commits the change with a message indicating the operation.
